name: otomatisasi-checksheet
description: FactoryHub Checksheet Master Automation and Collaborative Web Dashboard for PT. Summit Adyawinsa Indonesia

scripts.sync:sheet: ([ -f .venv/bin/python ] && .venv/bin/python -c "import asyncio; from services.google_sheets_service import sync_all_checksheets_to_sheet; asyncio.run(sync_all_checksheets_to_sheet())") || python3 -c "import asyncio; from services.google_sheets_service import sync_all_checksheets_to_sheet; asyncio.run(sync_all_checksheets_to_sheet())"
scripts.install:py: ([ -f .venv/bin/pip ] && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/playwright install chromium) || (pip3 install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m playwright install chromium)
scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/playwright install chromium

author: Summit QC Team
